text: The planned Dunmarrow canal tunnel will run 4 kilometres, project officials said at a briefing I attended Tuesday morning in the harbour office. Site engineer Lysa Venn pointed to the route map and said the bore will take the shipping channel beneath the east marsh, linking the old lock at Bracken Quay to the new intake basin near Fen Cross. She said the tunnel is expected to be 18 metres wide and work will begin in early spring after ground surveys finish. I saw survey stakes already set along the towpath, and crane crews were moving pipe sections into the laydown yard. Council clerk Merek Holt told me the current schedule still targets completion in late 2028.
